caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bucket-shaped object standing on a pedestal base. The bucket is cylindrical in shape, with visible vertical wooden panels and two horizontal brass bands encircling its upper and lower sections. There are brass handles affixed to either side of the bucket. The pedestal is turned and supports four curved legs, each ending in a brass caster. The entire object is rendered in shades of brown and gold, representing the wood and metal components. In the bottom left corner, there is a small technical sketch in red ink with measurements and a simplified outline of the object. The background is a light beige color, bordered by a thin red line. The artist’s name, James M. Lawson, and additional notations appear near the lower right corner.
title: Wine Cooler
